  • Exports

HEIF/HEIC facade (clean-room): container + uncompressed + JPEG-in-HEIF decode. Item/box layout per ISO/IEC 23008-12; uncompressed descriptors per ISO/IEC 23001-17. HEVC/VVC/AVC/EVC/JPEG2000 bitstreams stay Unsupported for pixels (passthrough via extractors). Supports stills, collections, derived grid/overlay/iden, tiled iloc construction-1/2, tiled uncC (clean-room "TL" tile-component profile), timed pict sequences incl. fragmented moov+moof (unci v0/v1 / jpeg) and EVC brands.
